$comment: Motion B v1. The renewal window is a commercial ATTENTION window, not a prediction. The incumbent platform is REQUIRED context and is never claimed from timing alone — `technology_in_use` must affirmatively name it. budget_reduction_target is not a disqualifier: cost pressure can strengthen a modernization case.
name: VMware Displacement / Datacenter Modernization
objective: Qualify and advance a virtualization and datacenter modernization opportunity, timed against a renewal the account is already facing.

requiresContext: Installed virtualization platform — until `technology_in_use` names it, an upcoming renewal makes modernization timely but does not establish displacement.
